irete-examples.ifa

Irete: Cryptography

SHA256 hashing, HMAC, and Base64 encoding (requires crypto feature).

Use Case 1: Password Hashing

// password_auth.ifa - Hash and verify passwords

ese hash_password(password, salt) {
    ayanmo salted = salt + password;
    pada Irete.sha256(salted);
}

ese verify_password(password, salt, stored_hash) {
    ayanmo hash = hash_password(password, salt);
    pada hash == stored_hash;
}

// Usage
ayanmo salt = "salt123";
ayanmo password = "my_secret";
ayanmo stored = hash_password(password, salt);
Irosu.fo("Hash: " + stored);

ti (verify_password("my_secret", salt, stored)) {
    Irosu.fo("Password correct");
} bibẹkọ {
    Irosu.fo("Wrong password");
}

Use Case 2: File Integrity Checker

// integrity.ifa - Generate and verify file hashes

ese hash_file(path) {
    ti (!Odi.wa(path)) {
        Irosu.kigbe("File not found");
        pada ofifo;
    }
    ayanmo content = Odi.ka(path);
    pada Irete.sha256(content);
}

ese verify_file(path, expected_hash) {
    ayanmo actual = hash_file(path);
    ti (actual == ofifo) {
        pada iro;
    }
    ayanmo match = actual == expected_hash;
    ti (match) {
        Irosu.fo("File integrity verified");
    } bibẹkọ {
        Irosu.kigbe("File hash mismatch");
    }
    pada match;
}

// Usage
ayanmo hash = hash_file("document.pdf");
Irosu.fo("SHA256: " + hash);

// Later, verify
verify_file("document.pdf", hash);

Use Case 3: Base64 Encoding

// encode.ifa - Base64 encode and decode data

ese encode_data(data) {
    ayanmo encoded = Irete.base64_encode(data);
    Irosu.fo("Encoded: " + encoded);
    pada encoded;
}

ese decode_data(encoded) {
    ayanmo decoded = Irete.base64_decode(encoded);
    Irosu.fo("Decoded: " + decoded);
    pada decoded;
}

// Usage
ayanmo secret = "Hello Ifa-Lang";
ayanmo enc = encode_data(secret);
ayanmo dec = decode_data(enc);
Irosu.fo("Match: " + (secret == dec));
